title: Restoring SETI budget and closed-door seminar to SETI scientists
summary: Dan Sheehan tells of Restoring SETI budget and closed-door seminar to SETI scientists, about 1977 at House of Representatives; Jet Propulsion Laboratory, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: House of Representatives; Jet Propulsion Laboratory

tellings.quote: I went with you know Rusty Schwab and a whole bunch of the schwier and a bunch of the other folks uh and we went around and talked to the Congress people and they put the money back in

plain: A lawyer named Dan Sheehan told podcast host Jesse Michels that in 1977 he helped get funding back for SETI, the scientific search for radio signals from alien civilisations, after Congress had cut it. He says he went around to members of Congress with astronaut Rusty Schweickart and others, and the money was put back, with a congressional researcher named Marcia Smith also part of the story. He says he also gave a closed-door seminar to SETI scientists at the Jet Propulsion Laboratory, a NASA space research centre in California.
